|strategy=By Dennis Jeffris

[[Frostbite]] is one of those cards that doesn't seem great, but actually is one of the best. You deploy a lone character to a [[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]] site. Make sure you have [[Houjix]] in your hand before you do this. Once you have deployed the character and done all the other stuff you have to do, end your turn. When the opponent deploys a ton of characters to that site he will instinctively battle. While you may have to lose 34 force, you have [[Houjix]], so use that. When you get [[Nightfall]], [[Frostbite]], and [[Ice Storm]] in your hand, deploy them to the site where he battled. All of his characters at that site will be missing ( don't deploy there either ). At the end of each turn, he will have to lose 2 force for each of his missing characters there.

This trick works for both sides:

First, make sure all of your characters on [[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]] are on enclosed vehicles, and that your opponent's characters are not. Play a [[Nightfall]] (or Sundown) on [[Hoth (location){{!}}Hoth]], then play an [[Ice Storm]]. Then top it off with a [[Frostbite]]. Your opponent loses 2 force per character at the end of every turn (yours and his).
